claim: A wall record has one x_repeat and one y_repeat, and they scale its masked middle and its step bands alike. Glass hung on a wall whose sides stand at different heights forces the facade band above and below it to the glass's scale.
evidence: NBlood/source/build/src/engine.cpp:4426 and :4435: the scale of every band is taken from wal->yrepeat
the owner, 2026-11-17: 'the glass should sit in an aperture/frame so glass texture scaling won't be colliding with facade texture'
use: Hang a pane, a grille or bars only on a wall between two sectors of the same floor and ceiling (a reveal and a sash pocket behind the facade line); the facade's record keeps the facade's scale.
